"}]</script><script>
const cards=JSON.parse(document.querySelector('#collection-data').textContent),tiles=[...document.querySelectorAll('.card')],search=document.querySelector('input'),rank=document.querySelector('#rank'),dialog=document.querySelector('dialog');let visible=cards.map((_,i)=>i),current=0;
function filter(){const q=search.value.toLowerCase().trim();visible=[];tiles.forEach((tile,i)=>{const c=cards[i],match=(c.name+' '+c.form+' '+c.design+' '+c.power.rank).toLowerCase().includes(q)&&(!rank.value||c.power.rank===rank.value);tile.hidden=!match;if(match)visible.push(i)});document.querySelector('.count').textContent=visible.length+' / '+cards.length+' cards';document.querySelector('.empty').hidden=visible.length>0}
search.addEventListener('input',filter);rank.addEventListener('change',filter);
function show(index){current=index;const c=cards[index],put=(id,value)=>document.getElementById(id).textContent=value;put('viewer-name',c.name);put('viewer-form',c.form);put('viewer-finish',c.design);put('viewer-grade','SHIELD HERO · '+c.power.rank);put('viewer-count',(visible.indexOf(index)+1)+' / '+visible.length);put('scope',c.power.scope);put('basis',c.power.basis);put('limits',c.power.limits);const image=document.querySelector('#viewer-image');image.src=c.image;image.alt=c.name+' · '+c.form+' · '+c.design;const refs=document.querySelector('#references');refs.replaceChildren();for(const [i,url] of [...new Set(c.power.references||[c.source])].entries()){const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.target='_blank';a.rel='noopener noreferrer';a.textContent=(i+1)+'. '+new URL(url).hostname;refs.append(a)}document.querySelector('.details details').open=false;dialog.scrollTop=0;if(!dialog.open)dialog.showModal()}
function move(step){const pos=visible.indexOf(current);show(visible[(pos+step+visible.length)%visible.length])}tiles.forEach((tile,i)=>tile.addEventListener('click',()=>show(i)));document.querySelector('#close').addEventListener('click',()=>dialog.close());document.querySelector('#previous').addEventListener('click',()=>move(-1));document.querySelector('#next').addEventListener('click',()=>move(1));dialog.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===dialog){const r=dialog.getBoundingClientRect();if(e.clientX<r.left||e.clientX>r.right||e.clientY<r.top||e.clientY>r.bottom)dialog.close()}});document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(dialog.open&&e.key==='ArrowRight'){e.preventDefault();move(1)}if(dialog.open&&e.key==='ArrowLeft'){e.preventDefault();move(-1)}});
</script></body></html>
